headline.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. (NYSE:OTF) Plans $0.05 Quarterly Dividend

summary.en: Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp. (NYSE:OTF) plans a $0.05 quarterly dividend, according to MarketBeat.
summary.zh: 据MarketBeat报道，Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp.（NYSE:OTF）计划派发每股0.05美元的季度股息。

headline.en: Apollo Global Management stock gains as AI financing boom supports outlook
headline.zh: Apollo Global Management股价上涨，AI融资热潮支撑其前景

summary.en: Apollo Global Management's stock gained as an AI financing boom supported its outlook, according to AD HOC NEWS. No figures or additional details were provided.
summary.zh: 据AD HOC NEWS报道，Apollo Global Management股价上涨，AI融资热潮支撑其前景。报道未提供具体数字或其他细节。

headline.en: Apollo Sees Higher-for-Longer Rates Fueling AI Infrastructure Financing Boom
headline.zh: Apollo 认为利率长期维持高位将推动 AI 基础设施融资热潮

summary.en: Apollo said that a higher-for-longer interest rate environment is fueling a boom in AI infrastructure financing. The article provides no further details on figures or participants.
summary.zh: Apollo 表示，利率长期维持高位正在推动 AI 基础设施融资热潮。文章未提供更多有关数据或参与方的细节。

headline.en: Morgan Stanley Again Limits Private Credit Redemptions as Investors Seek 11% Exit
headline.zh: Morgan Stanley 再次限制私人信贷赎回，投资者寻求赎回约11%

summary.en: Morgan Stanley again limited redemptions from its private credit fund as investors sought to exit about 11% of the vehicle. No other details were available in the article.
summary.zh: Morgan Stanley 再次限制其私人信贷基金的赎回，投资者寻求赎回约11%的基金份额。文章未提供其他细节。
